The [public cut record](../../Changes/Research/Readers/SolidWorks/SolidWorksCutOperation.md) preserves the resolved target and termination. The [cut perimeter and saved face](../../Changes/Research/Readers/SolidWorks/SolidWorksCutFacePlacement.md) now enter the normal neutral document. The [CutSketch constraints](../../Changes/Research/Readers/SolidWorks/SolidWorksCutDimensionRoles.md) retain their ordered operands and distinguish driving sizes from equation-owned offsets. The [active partition](../../Changes/Research/Readers/SolidWorks/SolidWorksActivePartition.md) supplies the saved SOLIDWORKS body and its topology. Independent editable acceptance remains open
